title: Power Pages: self-service site ownership transfer in the admin centre
summary: Hold: the Microsoft Graph call for adding a website app owner omits the required request body identifying the new owner, so it cannot perform the advertised action as printed. The roadmap facts, transfer prerequisites, navigation paths and other listed calls are supported; the governance checklist also names setup controls missing from the table.

claims.claim: The printed POST https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/applications/{application-object-id}/owners/$ref call adds the selected website app owner.
claims.fix: Keep the documented endpoint but append: with body {"@odata.id":"https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/directoryObjects/{new-owner-user-object-id}"}. The current call omits the required owner reference entirely. The existing cited troubleshooting page shows this body, and https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/api/application-post-owners?view=graph-rest-1.0 confirms individual users are valid owners. Keep the note that this is a general app-ownership API, not the site-transfer API.
